spec.title: Partitions at minimum ISR
spec.description: Number of partitions which are at their minimum in sync replica count (| ISR | == | min.insync.replicas |)

spec.title: Partitions under minimum ISR
spec.description: Number of partitions which are under their minimum in sync replica count (| ISR | < | min.insync.replicas |)

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    "Seq",
    COUNT(*) AS "count"
FROM "raw"
WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL '3 hours'
GROUP BY "Seq"
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

SELECT (time - (to_timestamp("Trade_Time") - interval '9 hours')) AS "delay","time"
  -- (time - (to_timestamp("Timestamp_Web"))) AS "produce_delay",
  -- "Price","Spark_Time","Symbol", "Trade_Time","Timestamp_Web","time"
  FROM "raw" 
  WHERE time >= now() - interval '7 seconds'
  ORDER BY "time"

SELECT ("time" - (to_timestamp("Timestamp_Web"))) AS "produce_delay","time"
  FROM "raw" 
  WHERE time >= now() - interval '7 seconds'
  ORDER BY "time"

SELECT count(*) FROM "raw"
WHERE time >= now() - interval '30 minutes' 
 and "Hash_Spark" != "Hash_Web"

SELECT
    "Partition",
    "Offset",
    "prev_offset"
FROM (
    SELECT
        "Partition",
        "Offset",
        LAG("Offset") OVER (
            PARTITION BY "Partition"
            ORDER BY "Offset"
        ) AS "prev_offset"
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            "Partition",
            "Offset"
        FROM "raw"
        WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL '60 minutes'
    ) AS offsets
) AS t
WHERE "Offset" - "prev_offset" > 1
ORDER BY "Partition", "Offset"

SELECT
"Seq",
"prev_seq"
FROM (
SELECT
"Seq",
LAG("Seq") OVER (
ORDER BY "Seq"
) AS "prev_seq"
FROM "raw"
WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
)
WHERE "Seq" - "prev_seq" > 1
